_meta.how_to_regression_diff: Re-run cases (npm run check:golden pep). Diff for QUALITY not exact match: HTTP 200, no truncation. FOCUSED REBUILD (2026-09-05): installed from an owner-supplied rewrite (audit/tool-notes/PEP-NOTES.md) that reduces the prior FULL V2 REWRITE's five modes (Right Now/Prioritize/Week/Patterns/Adapt, 17 actions) down to ONE loop across 3 actions: generate (Right Now menu), just-do-this (single suggestion, no menu), reflect (log what happened). Prioritize/Week/Patterns/Adapt/Shared menu/Match/build-a-plan are GONE, not renamed — do not resurrect their schema keys chasing a 'completeness' instinct. New schema: generate={read,top_pick:{activity,why_it_fits,first_step,duration,done_when},alternatives:[{activity,why_it_fits,duration}],history_note}; just-do-this={activity,why_it_fits,first_step,duration,done_when,history_note}; reflect={reflection,history_observation}. LIVE-CAUGHT BUG, fixed same day: the SYSTEM prompt's own 'avoid absolutes about effort' rule listed the banned phrases ('zero effort, no attention, no decisions, completely passive') as a literal example list, and the model echoed them back near-verbatim on the FIRST test call ('This requires zero setup, zero decisions, and zero physical effort') — the model was handed a copyable bad-phrase template and copied it. Fixed by describing the constraint without listing the banned words as an example set. The validateResult() regex backstop ALSO missed this on the first pass — its 260-char/2-sentence cap (meant to spare a long paragraph from being nuked over one incidental match) let a 3-sentence field with a genuine, repeated 'zero X' violation straight through; raised to 400 chars/3 sentences. Both fixes verified together: re-ran the exact failing input, output came back clean ('asks very little... no setup, no goal, no output' — describing fit, not claiming zero demand). The generate-low-energy-evening-screens case captured here IS that exact regression input — re-running it and finding a 'zero setup/effort/decisions/attention' phrase anywhere in the output is the bug back. DO NOT reintroduce: any of the removed modes' schema keys; a prompt rule that lists banned phrases as a literal copyable example set (describe the constraint, don't hand over the phrase); the tight 260/2 validateResult cap (400/3 is the corrected value).

input.context: Been staring at screens all day, doom-scrolling between meetings. A hike sounds awful right now.

output.read: Screens all day at a 2/10, with 15 minutes and no appetite for anything effortful. The goal is something with barely any setup and very little to decide.

top_pick.activity: Sit somewhere away from your screen — a chair, the floor, a window — and just look at something still for a few minutes
top_pick.why_it_fits: You have been visually active all day with fast-moving content. This asks very little: no setup, no goal, no output. It fits your location, your time, and a 2/10 capacity because you do not have to do anything except stop.
top_pick.first_step: Close or turn away from whatever screen you are on, pick a spot in your home that is not in front of a device, and sit down.
top_pick.duration: Up to 10 minutes, or less if that is all you want
top_pick.done_when: When you decide to stop — there is no task to complete

alternatives.activity: Put on one familiar album or playlist you already know well and lie down or sit with your eyes closed
alternatives.why_it_fits: Something familiar requires very little attention — you are not picking tracks or following anything new. It fits 15 minutes, your location, and barely asks anything of you physically.
alternatives.duration: One album side or a few songs, whatever the 15 minutes allows

input.context: Meeting in 10 minutes and I cannot decide anything else right now.

output.activity: Sit still and look out a window or at a fixed point in the room
output.why_it_fits: You have 10 minutes, no energy to spare, and a meeting starting at the end of that window. This asks very little setup, attention, or decision-making — you stay exactly where you are and do not start anything new that you will have to stop.
output.first_step: Put your phone face-down, find a spot to rest your eyes, and let your hands sit idle.
output.duration: As long as feels right up to about 8 minutes, leaving a couple of minutes to gather yourself before the meeting.
output.done_when: When you notice the meeting is about to start and you are ready to shift attention to it.
output.history_note: No saved activities or past attempts on record, so this is based only on what you described right now.

input.note: Felt better once I was outside

output.reflection: You rated this 8/10 for helpfulness, and your energy self-report went from 3 to 6 — a 3-point rise — with a note that being outside felt better. Worth keeping in mind for similar moments.
